verdict.rationale: A hands-on customer report says Datadog's main advantage is correlating APM traces, custom metrics and logs through tagging that is densely linked across the platform. First-party APM, Log Management and OpenTelemetry docs exist, though the pack shows only their titles. One critic calls Datadog's correlation weak compared with Honeycomb, Dynatrace and Instana, but that is a comparative opinion rather than a concrete failure of span-to-log linking, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation detail on span-to-log/metric correlation (e.g. trace ID injection into logs, one-click navigation from span to logs), and explicit evidence of jumping from a span to its correlated infrastructure metrics.
